panels.title: Stream Status Grid
panels.description: Shows status of all Silver layer streams with last record time and health indicator. Green = healthy, Yellow = warning (stale), Red = critical (very stale or no data).

targets.rawSql:
-- Stream Status Grid: Config-driven query that auto-discovers all Silver streams
-- Queries each Silver table to get latest record, calculates freshness and status
-- Thresholds: Based on expected update intervals per stream type
--   air_quality_observations: ~30s expected, yellow >60s, red >120s
--   weather_observations: ~10min expected, yellow >20min, red >40min
--   outdoor_air_quality: ~10min expected, yellow >20min, red >40min
--   weather_forecasts: ~1h expected, yellow >2h, red >4h

WITH stream_stats AS (
    -- Air Quality Observations (indoor sensors, ~30s updates)
    SELECT 
        'air_quality_observations' AS stream_name,
        'Air Quality (Indoor)' AS display_name,
        MAX(observation_time) AS last_record_time,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records_24h,
        60 AS yellow_threshold_seconds,
        120 AS red_threshold_seconds
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Weather Observations (NWS stations, ~10min updates)
    SELECT 
        'weather_observations' AS stream_name,
        'Weather Observations (NWS)' AS display_name,
        MAX(observation_time) AS last_record_time,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records_24h,
        1200 AS yellow_threshold_seconds,  -- 20 minutes
        2400 AS red_threshold_seconds       -- 40 minutes
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Outdoor Air Quality (OWM API, ~10min updates)
    SELECT 
        'outdoor_air_quality' AS stream_name,
        'Outdoor Air Quality (OWM)' AS display_name,
        MAX(observation_time) AS last_record_time,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records_24h,
        1200 AS yellow_threshold_seconds,  -- 20 minutes
        2400 AS red_threshold_seconds       -- 40 minutes
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Weather Forecasts (NWS gridpoints, ~1h updates)
    SELECT 
        'weather_forecasts' AS stream_name,
        'Weather Forecasts (NWS)' AS display_name,
        MAX(ingestion_time) AS last_record_time,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records_24h,
        7200 AS yellow_threshold_seconds,   -- 2 hours
        14400 AS red_threshold_seconds      -- 4 hours
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT 
    display_name AS "Stream",
    COALESCE(TO_CHAR(last_record_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'No Data') AS "Last Record",
    CASE 
        WHEN last_record_time IS NULL THEN 'No Data'
        ELSE CONCAT(
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_record_time))::INTEGER / 60,
            'm ',
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_record_time))::INTEGER % 60,
            's ago'
        )
    END AS "Time Since Last",
    total_records_24h AS "Records (24h)",
    CASE 
        WHEN last_record_time IS NULL THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_record_time)) > red_threshold_seconds THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_record_time)) > yellow_threshold_seconds THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'HEALTHY'
    END AS "Status"
FROM stream_stats
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN last_record_time IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_record_time)) > red_threshold_seconds THEN 1
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_record_time)) > yellow_threshold_seconds THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    stream_name;

panels.title: Air Quality Freshness
panels.description: Time since last indoor air quality reading. Expected: ~30 seconds. Yellow >1min, Red >2min.

targets.rawSql:
-- Air Quality Freshness: Time in seconds since last record
-- Expected update interval: ~30 seconds (AirGradient MQTT)
-- Thresholds: Green <60s, Yellow 60-120s, Red >120s

SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(observation_time))),
        9999  -- Return high value if no data
    )::INTEGER AS "Seconds Since Last"
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Weather Obs Freshness
panels.description: Time since last NWS weather observation. Expected: ~10 minutes. Yellow >20min, Red >40min.

targets.rawSql:
-- Weather Observations Freshness: Time in seconds since last record
-- Expected update interval: ~10 minutes (NWS HTTP poll)
-- Thresholds: Green <1200s (20min), Yellow 1200-2400s, Red >2400s (40min)

SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(observation_time))),
        99999  -- Return high value if no data
    )::INTEGER AS "Seconds Since Last"
FROM silver.weather_observations
WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Outdoor AQ Freshness
panels.description: Time since last outdoor air quality reading. Expected: ~10 minutes. Yellow >20min, Red >40min.

targets.rawSql:
-- Outdoor Air Quality Freshness: Time in seconds since last record
-- Expected update interval: ~10 minutes (OpenWeatherMap HTTP poll)
-- Thresholds: Green <1200s (20min), Yellow 1200-2400s, Red >2400s (40min)

SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(observation_time))),
        99999  -- Return high value if no data
    )::INTEGER AS "Seconds Since Last"

panels.title: Forecast Freshness
panels.description: Time since last weather forecast ingestion. Expected: ~1 hour. Yellow >2h, Red >4h.

targets.rawSql:
-- Weather Forecast Freshness: Time in seconds since last ingestion
-- Expected update interval: ~1 hour (NWS gridpoints forecast)
-- Uses ingestion_time since forecasts have future valid_times
-- Thresholds: Green <7200s (2h), Yellow 7200-14400s, Red >14400s (4h)

SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(ingestion_time))),
        99999  -- Return high value if no data
    )::INTEGER AS "Seconds Since Last"
FROM silver.weather_forecasts
WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Record Count by Stream (24h)
panels.description: Total number of records ingested in the last 24 hours per stream. Helps identify under-performing data sources.

targets.rawSql:
-- Record Volume: Count of records per stream in last 24 hours
-- Config-driven: Dynamically queries all Silver tables
-- Expected approximate counts (24h):
--   air_quality: ~2880 (1 per 30s * 60min * 48h / 2)
--   weather_obs: ~144 (1 per 10min * 24h)
--   outdoor_aq: ~144 (1 per 10min * 24h)
--   forecasts: ~24+ (depends on forecast horizon coverage)

WITH stream_counts AS (
    SELECT 'Air Quality' AS stream, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 'Weather Obs' AS stream, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 'Outdoor AQ' AS stream, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 'Forecasts' AS stream, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT stream, record_count
FROM stream_counts
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

panels.title: Total Records (24h)
panels.description: Total count of all records across all Silver layer streams in the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
-- Total Record Count: Sum across all Silver streams
-- Quick health check: total should be in the thousands for 24h

SELECT 
    (
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.air_quality_observations WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') +
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.weather_observations WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') +
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') +
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.weather_forecasts WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')
    ) AS total_records;

panels.title: Active Streams
panels.description: Number of streams with data in the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
-- Active Streams Count: Number of streams with recent data
-- Expected: 4 (all streams operational)
-- Less than 4 indicates a stream is not receiving data

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_streams FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS stream_active
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 1 AS stream_active
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 1 AS stream_active
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 1 AS stream_active
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
) AS active;

panels.title: Oldest Record Age
panels.description: Age of the oldest unfresh record across all streams. Identifies the most stale data source.

targets.rawSql:
-- Oldest Record Age: Maximum staleness across all streams
-- Identifies the most delayed data source
-- Useful for quick health check: if this is green, all streams are fresh

SELECT MAX(seconds_since_last) AS max_staleness_seconds FROM (
    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(observation_time)))::INTEGER AS seconds_since_last
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(observation_time)))::INTEGER AS seconds_since_last
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(observation_time)))::INTEGER AS seconds_since_last
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(ingestion_time)))::INTEGER AS seconds_since_last
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) AS staleness;

panels.title: Records per Stream (Detailed)
panels.description: Detailed breakdown of record counts with expected vs actual comparison.

targets.rawSql:
-- Detailed Record Stats: Compare actual vs expected counts
-- Expected counts based on typical update intervals:
--   air_quality: 2880 (1/30s * 86400s)
--   weather_obs: 144 (1/10min * 24h)
--   outdoor_aq: 144 (1/10min * 24h)
--   forecasts: 24 (1/hour * 24h, minimum)

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        'Air Quality' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS actual,
        2880 AS expected,
        ROUND(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 2880 * 100, 1) AS completeness_pct
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'Weather Obs' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS actual,
        144 AS expected,
        ROUND(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 144 * 100, 1) AS completeness_pct
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'Outdoor AQ' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS actual,
        144 AS expected,
        ROUND(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 144 * 100, 1) AS completeness_pct
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'Forecasts' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS actual,
        24 AS expected,
        ROUND(LEAST(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 24 * 100, 100), 1) AS completeness_pct
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT 
    stream AS "Stream",
    actual AS "Actual",
    expected AS "Expected",
    completeness_pct AS "Completeness %"
FROM stats
ORDER BY completeness_pct ASC;

panels.title: DQ Flag Summary
panels.description: Shows percentage of records with data quality flags per stream. Lower is better. DQ flags indicate records that failed validation rules.

targets.rawSql:
-- DQ Flag Summary: Percentage of records with non-null, non-empty dq_flags
-- Lower is better - indicates cleaner data
-- dq_flags is TEXT[] array containing rule violation identifiers
-- Records with dq_flags indicate data that passed but with warnings

WITH dq_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        'Air Quality' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged_records
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'Weather Obs' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged_records
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'Outdoor AQ' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged_records
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'Forecasts' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged_records
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT 
    stream AS "Stream",
    total_records AS "Total Records",
    flagged_records AS "Flagged Records",
    CASE 
        WHEN total_records = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(flagged_records::NUMERIC / total_records * 100, 2)
    END AS "DQ Flag %"
FROM dq_stats
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN total_records = 0 THEN 0 ELSE flagged_records::NUMERIC / total_records END DESC;

panels.title: DQ Flag Distribution
panels.description: Breakdown of flagged vs clean records across all streams.

targets.rawSql:
-- DQ Flag Distribution: Overall clean vs flagged records
-- Aggregates across all Silver tables
-- Useful for quick assessment of overall data quality

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT SUM(total) AS total_records, SUM(flagged) AS flagged_records
    FROM totals
)
SELECT 'Clean Records' AS category, (total_records - flagged_records) AS count FROM aggregated
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Flagged Records' AS category, flagged_records AS count FROM aggregated;

panels.title: Overall DQ Rate
panels.description: Percentage of all records that have DQ flags. Target: <5%.

targets.rawSql:
-- Overall DQ Rate: Percentage of all records with DQ flags
-- Target: <5% is excellent, <15% is acceptable, >30% needs investigation
-- Calculates across all Silver tables weighted by record count

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dq_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(dq_flags, 1) > 0) AS flagged
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(total) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(SUM(flagged)::NUMERIC / SUM(total) * 100, 2)
    END AS dq_rate_pct
FROM totals;

panels.title: Ingestion Timeline (Records per Hour)
panels.description: Stacked area chart showing record count over time by stream. Helps identify gaps or spikes in data ingestion.

targets.rawSql:
-- Ingestion Timeline: Hourly record counts per stream
-- Uses time_bucket for efficient grouping (TimescaleDB function)
-- Shows data volume patterns and identifies gaps
-- Formatted for Grafana time series: time column + value columns

WITH hourly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        time_bucket('1 hour', observation_time) AS time,
        'Air Quality' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        time_bucket('1 hour', observation_time) AS time,
        'Weather Obs' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        time_bucket('1 hour', observation_time) AS time,
        'Outdoor AQ' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        time_bucket('1 hour', ingestion_time) AS time,
        'Forecasts' AS stream,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE ingestion_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND ingestion_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    time,
    stream AS metric,
    record_count AS value
FROM hourly_counts
ORDER BY time, stream;

panels.title: Recent Temperature Readings
panels.description: Sample temperature data showing the temp_unit variable in action. Demonstrates Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle capability.

targets.rawSql:
-- Temperature with Unit Toggle: Demonstrates temp_unit variable
-- Uses conditional conversion based on dashboard variable
-- ${temp_unit} is replaced by Grafana with 'Celsius' or 'Fahrenheit'
-- Conversion formula: F = (C * 9/5) + 32

WITH temp_data AS (
    SELECT 
        time_bucket('15 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
        'Indoor' AS source,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' 
                THEN (COALESCE(temperature_c_compensated, temperature_c) * 9.0/5.0) + 32
                ELSE COALESCE(temperature_c_compensated, temperature_c)
            END
        ) AS temperature
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
      AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        time_bucket('15 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
        'Outdoor' AS source,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' 
                THEN (temperature_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32
                ELSE temperature_c
            END
        ) AS temperature
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
      AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    time,
    source AS metric,
    ROUND(temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM temp_data
WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, source;
